questions.question_english: Rule 47 of the DSER 1973 deals with the absorption of surplus employees. When does an employee become "surplus"?

With reference to the following, consider these statements regarding 'Leave Encashment' for school employees:
I. Teachers are generally vacation staff and are entitled to fewer days of Earned Leave compared to non-vacation staff.

questions.explanation_english: I and III only Teachers are vacation staff entitled to fewer Earned Leave days, and Earned Leave accumulated up to 300 days can be encashed upon superannuation. questions.question_english: With reference to the Delhi School Education Act, 1973, which term refers to a school established and administered by a minority having the right to do so under clause (1) of Article 30 of the Constitution?
questions.explanation_english: Minority school Section 2(o) of the Delhi School Education Act, 1973 defines a "minority school" as a school established and administered by a religious or linguistic minority having the fundamental right to do so under Article 30(1) of the Constitution of India. These institutions enjoy statutory protection and operational autonomy regarding administrative governance and personnel management within constitutional boundaries.

questions.question_english:
With reference to the following, consider these statements regarding the 'Medical Examination' of students:
I. Every recognized school must arrange for the medical examination of its students at least once a year.
II. A cumulative medical record must be maintained for each student.
III. The school must run a full-fledged hospital on its premises. Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements I and II are correct. Periodic medical examination and a cumulative health record allow a school to notice health needs, maintain continuity of care and refer a pupil for further assessment when required. These obligations do not mean that every school must operate a full hospital on its premises. Schools should arrange appropriate examination and documentation within the framework prescribed by the Rules and relevant health guidance.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन I और II सही हैं। नियमित चिकित्सा-जाँच और विद्यार्थी का संचयी स्वास्थ्य-अभिलेख स्वास्थ्य संबंधी जरूरतों की पहचान, अनुवर्ती कार्रवाई और अभिभावकों/स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं के साथ समन्वय में सहायता करते हैं। लेकिन इन अपेक्षाओं का अर्थ यह नहीं है कि हर विद्यालय को अपने परिसर में पूर्ण विकसित अस्पताल संचालित करना होगा। जाँच और रिकॉर्ड रखने की जिम्मेदारी को अस्पताल चलाने की अतिरंजित शर्त से अलग समझना चाहिए।
